rules.crossings: walkable nodes 8-60 m apart across a motorway, trunk road or river, whose walk along the network is over 3 times as long; one per 100 m, biggest saving first
rules.railbed_walkway: the corridor line cut where it crosses walkable ways (the access points) and at the rail-bed site boundaries
